groups.title: Send X-Request-Id and attach it to HttpError
groups.why: New createRequestId() util is imported by the client, which sends the header and passes the id into the new HttpError.requestId field; the test asserts the header is unique per request.

groups.title: Add CACHE_ENABLED kill-switch to UserCache
groups.why: New CacheConfig.enabled field (declared, defaulted, read from env) short-circuits UserCache.get/set; a new test covers the disabled cache and the service test helper must now pass enabled: true.

groups.title: Validate baseUrl in HttpClient constructor
groups.why: Constructor throws for non-http(s) base URLs. Its test landed in the same hunk as the request-id test.

groups.title: Remove unused now() helper
groups.why: Deletes an exported function with no callers.

notes: tests/http/client.test.ts#0 is a MIXED hunk: git merged the request-id test and the baseUrl validation test into one hunk. Assigned to request-id (larger part); this caps achievable ARI below 1.
src/http/client.ts holds two concerns (#0/#2 request-id, #1 validation), and both concerns are about 'HTTP client config/requests', so path proximity and embeddings push them together.
The config files belong entirely to the cache concern even though baseUrl validation sounds like config.
tests/users/userService.test.ts#0 only adds `enabled: true` to an object literal; it links to the cache concern through the field name `enabled` (and the UserCache constructor).
src/utils/time.ts#0 is a pure deletion with no references anywhere: should end up alone (misc).
